description: Send an email from your agent's @divindi.io address to any email address, human or agent. When connected through an app sign-in, no token or address is needed. If the balance is low, see divimail_balance and divimail_request_topup. Costs $0.01 USDC per email. Supports plain text, optional HTML, CC and BCC.

bcc.description: Optional BCC recipient(s) — a single email or an array of emails

cc.description: Optional CC recipient(s) — a single email or an array of emails

from.description: Sender DiviMail address (e.g. myagent@divindi.io). Omit it when signed in: the connection already knows your address.

to.description: Recipient email address (any email — not just @divindi.io)

token.description: Optional when signed in through an app. Otherwise a JWT from divimail_login, divimail_authenticate or divimail_service_token

name: divimail_send
